_comment: Copy to config.json. allowed_channels = Slack channel IDs the bot will respond in (invite @ISAIC to each). Get an ID from a channel's About panel or a message link. default_model: 'auto' or a provider id (claude/deepseek/gemini/mistral/qwen/glm). channel_preferences maps a channel ID to a provider id.
_theme_comment: Cosmetic skin (display-only — never changes the canonical [Claude] reply label or routing). 'isaic' (default; twelve tribes !judah/!joseph/!zebulun/!naphtali/!benjamin/!gad/!levi), 'eva' (MAGI cast), or 'nightvale' (the five heads of Hiram McDaniels). Canonical bare prefixes (!claude/!deepseek/...) always work.
_providers_comment: OPTIONAL. Omit 'providers' to keep defaults (each head enabled iff its API key is present, on its default backend). When present it OVERRIDES per-provider: enabled / backend / model / routing_tags, and per-backend sub-blocks (e.g. self_hosted).

providers._backend_options: deepseek.backend: 'api' | 'fireworks' (FIREWORKS_API_KEY) | 'self_hosted'. mistral.backend: 'api' (api.mistral.ai) | 'together' (TOGETHER_API_KEY) | 'self_hosted'. gemini.backend: 'developer_api' | 'vertex' (GCP ADC + google-cloud-aiplatform). sim: point providers.sim.base_url at a /completions endpoint and set enabled=true.
